reviews_verbatim.author: Daniel DeTommaso
reviews_verbatim.text: Adriana did an exceptional job with my massage. The hot stones was a great touch and her techniques are top notch. Would recommend to anyone looking for a great massage!!!

reviews_verbatim.author: Kenneth
reviews_verbatim.text: Adriana did a great mobile massage on my back at my home. She has a very sweet personality and she was very professional. I would definitely use her service again in the future.

reviews_verbatim.author: Paul Greco
reviews_verbatim.text: Adriana did a great massage and has a warm personality. She helped get rid of the pain in my back. Will book again. Anyone looking for a mobile massage please contact this lovely lady. 11 stars.

reviews_verbatim.author: Salvatore LaRosa
reviews_verbatim.text: Great mobile massage at my home, and coffee eye mask were great. Very sweet lady. Will book Adriana again when I’m in town.

reviews_verbatim.author: Jason Williams
reviews_verbatim.text: I had an excellent experience with this mobile massage service. The therapist arrived on time, was professional, courteous, and well-prepared. The massage was both therapeutic and deeply relaxing, with great attention to the areas that … (truncated by Google).

inventory.verdict: REJECTED: generic third-party product stock photo, not the business's own photo, text/branding of another company baked into the image.

inventory.desc: A massage being performed on a man's bare back in an ornate mansion room with a chandelier and french doors, by a therapist whose face/build does NOT match the woman in gmaps-1/4/7/8.
inventory.verdict: REJECTED: different person entirely, almost certainly a generic/stock 'luxury mobile massage' marketing image not of this business, per the rule that photos of other people/accounts do not count.

inventory.desc: Close-up selfie of the same woman as gmaps-1/2, black scrub embroidered 'Massage Therapist', candles and rolled towels in the background.
inventory.verdict: Same as gmaps-1/2: plausible real therapist selfie, avatar-only, not a gallery tile, and a duplicate of an already-counted image.

photos.curation_note: After removing exact duplicates (1=2, 7=8), a third-party product stock photo (5), and a photo of a visibly different person in a different setting (6), only ONE real, own, work-context photo remains (gmaps-4) plus two duplicate face-selfies usable only as a small avatar. That is far below the FORGE-BRIEF 0.b hard minimum of 5 real, own photos (stock images and photos of other accounts/people explicitly do not count toward that minimum).

fail_reason: Minimo de fotos NO cumplido tras curaduria visual estricta. De las 8 fotos de la ficha de Google (via gmaps_photocycle.js, research no degradado), 2 son duplicados exactos de una selfie de la terapeuta (uso valido solo como avatar pequeno, nunca como tile de galeria), 1 es una foto de producto de un proveedor externo no relacionado (Mion Artisan Soap), y 1 muestra a una persona visiblemente distinta en otro entorno (mansion con candelabro), que no corresponde a la misma terapeuta de las demas fotos: estas 2 ultimas son fotos de stock/de otra cuenta y NO cuentan segun la regla dura. Queda 1 sola foto de trabajo real verificable (gmaps-4). Sin Instagram ni Facebook propios encontrados (2 busquedas web dirigidas, cero resultados) para rescatar mas fotos reales. Por debajo del minimo duro de 5 fotos reales y propias de FORGE-BRIEF seccion 0.b.
